_meta.title: SortMyCover Meta Instant Form v3 (generic consent, CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form): Mark's Instant Form arm
_meta.supersedes: deliverables/media-buyer/instant-form-spec-v2.json (18 Oct 2026: named the practice and FSP number in the required box, CONSENT-NAMED-v5web, and asked "Do you have any life, disability or income cover now?"). Never build the v2 form.
_meta.why: SOCIAL-AUDIT-LINDI-SMC-2026-10-21.md row 22 + section 5 item 8: no income band, no "are you insured" or "which insurer", no health or disability questions; a custom disclaimer with a required checkbox (WhatsApp contact about a call with an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider, 18 or older, reply STOP to opt out, plus the privacy link), recorded as CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form; no practice name or FSP number in the form.
_meta.build: Built by hand in Ads Manager from this file (SortMyCover Page > Instant forms > Create form). Type every string exactly as given; "chars" is its length. Meta publishes no character limits for instant-form fields: the builder shows a live counter and refuses anything too long. If the builder ever truncates a string, stop and report it (never shorten or edit the consent text).
_meta.api_alternative: The same form via the Graph API (POST /{page_id}/leadgen_forms, automation/ads/meta-ads.js createLeadgenForm, human confirm token) sets the question and checkbox keys exactly. A form built by hand may get keys chosen by Meta; W01 then matches each answer on its exact option label, so the labels below must not be edited.
_meta.gate: Build it only after the Lead Ads terms are accepted for the Sort My Cover Page (facebook.com/ads/leadgen/tos). Publishing the ad is Jono's step. See DEPLOY-INSTANT-FORM.md.
rules_applied: No "free", "costs nothing", "no cost", "licensed", "AI", "Lead Velocity" (except inside the verbatim consent text) or "Capital Legacy" anywhere on the form.
No budget, income or other financial question, no email (Meta Lead Ads: financial information needs prior permission).

No insurance question: not "are you insured", not "which insurer", no policy details (Meta Lead Ads: insurance information needs prior permission). The v2 cover question is gone; existing cover is asked on WhatsApp / the /start/ page after consent.

No health or disability question (nothing about the person's health, conditions or disability). The intent question names the cover types the person wants help with; it asks nothing about the person's health.

No practice name, adviser name or FSP number anywhere on the form: the consent is generic, and the adviser is named to the person before any hand-over (lib/w01.mjs routeExisting: disclosure before routing for every generic consent).
Every age is accepted and nothing routes out on an answer (Jono, 18 Oct 2026, the /start/ decision): no conditional logic, no disqualifying ending.
Consent box unticked by default and required; the ad-measurement box is a separate optional box, unticked (site rule S22: optional, neither choice preselected).

form_type.note: Adds the review screen before submit.

sharing.note: Only people the ad is delivered to can submit: organic shares would arrive outside the test cell and skew the A/B read.

tracking_parameters.note: Settings > Tracking parameters. Optional; the arm is also known from the campaign / ad ids W01 stores.

headline.text: Book a 30-minute call with an authorised adviser

description_bullets.text: Lindi from SortMyCover sends you a Start here link on WhatsApp.
We'll confirm on WhatsApp: quick answers, no call centre or waiting on hold.
You talk to an adviser for 30 minutes, by phone or video.
SortMyCover gives no financial advice, product comparisons or premium quotes.

description.text: These help the adviser prepare for your call.

questions_section.order_note: Exactly this order: the two custom questions, then the two prefill fields.

label.text: What would you like help with?

questions.mapping_note: Disability cover and Income protection are two options on the form and one /start/ intent (income, help_with disability_income); the exact option is kept in conv_state.start.intent_option for the adviser. "Not sure yet" = /start/ review. product_interest is life_cover for all five (wills are never offered on this form).

label.text: Which age group are you in?

questions.note: Every answer is accepted. 35 to 50 can be qualified (after the monthly amount, asked on the /start/ page, never in this form); Under 35 / Over 50 book like anyone, are never marked qualified, and get a timeline note (OUT_OF_BAND_AGE_BOOKS).

Prefill question "Phone number". If the builder lets you rename the field, use "WhatsApp number"; if not, keep the prefill label: the intro, the section description and the thank-you screen all say WhatsApp. W01 normalises to +27 and checks it is a mobile (Twilio Lookup) before any message.

not_asked: budget / monthly premium / income (asked on the /start/ page the start_here WhatsApp template opens; before that template is approved: the qualify_budget template).
existing cover, insurer, policy number or amounts (Meta: insurance information). Asked after consent, on WhatsApp or the /start/ page (the four-option cover question there).
health, medical conditions or disability status (Meta restricted category; never asked on the form).
ID number, debt or any other financial detail
call preference (the method is chosen when booking)

custom_disclaimer.ui: Privacy > Custom disclaimer: on. Two checkboxes, neither ticked by default.

body.text: Please read and tick to continue. The second box is optional.

checkboxes.text: I agree that SortMyCover, a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd, may message me on WhatsApp to book and remind me about a call with an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider, and may share my details with that adviser, who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about that call. I am 18 or older. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP. Privacy notice: https://sortmycover.co.za/privacy/
checkboxes.source: automation/lib/w01.mjs LEAD_AD_FORM_CONSENT (the one source; W02 records this exact text on intake). Must stay EXACTLY equal to consentRegistry()["CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form"]; automation/tests/W02-instant-form-v3.test.mjs fails otherwise. It carries the four parts the audit asks for: WhatsApp contact about a call with an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider; 18 or older; reply STOP to opt out; the privacy link. No practice name or FSP number.

checkboxes.text: I give SortMyCover permission to use my details in coded (hashed) form to measure and improve its ads on Facebook and Instagram. It will never use them to send me ads by message. This is optional, and the call does not depend on it.
checkboxes.source: sites/sortmycover/config/consent.json ads.text verbatim. Ticked -> leads.consent_ads_at (the CAPI Lead event is allowed); unticked -> no ad-measurement use.

custom_disclaimer.why_two_boxes: The ad-measurement consent is optional on the site (rule S22). Folding it into the required box would make it a condition of the call, which its own wording ("This is optional, and the call does not depend on it") rules out. So the required box carries the generic text alone (CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form), and ad measurement is its own optional box with its own version (CONSENT-ADS-v2web).

description.text: Lindi will send you a Start here link on WhatsApp in a moment. Tap it to pick a time for your call.

after_submit: W02 webhook (leadgen) -> Graph fetch (field_data + custom_disclaimer_responses) -> the ingest item carries consent { text_version: CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form, text: the exact checkbox text } -> W01 Lead core: leads.consent_text / consent_text_version / consent_mode = generic / consent_at / consent_source = lead_ad, the consent_audit timeline row (known_version + matches_registry), consent_ads_at only when the optional box was ticked. Stored UNROUTED like a /start/ lead (routing_reason start_page_pending, conv_state { state: start_page, via: start_page, start { intent, intent_option, form_id, at, via: lead_ad }, help_with }).

First WhatsApp within 60 s: the start_here template (Hi {first name}, button Start here -> sortmycover.co.za/start/#lt=<lead token>), through smc-whatsapp-send. It answers the person's own request seconds after the submit. Gate: WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=twilio + TWILIO_CONTENT_SIDS.start_here + LEAD_TOKEN_SECRET (lib/w01.mjs startHereReady).

/start/ v4 (W39): pick a time, the adviser card with the SortMyCover disclosure (START-DISCLOSE-v1) names the adviser, firm and FSP before routing (generic consent: never routed before that), then the answers. CAPI Lead once, at the hand-over (consent_ads only).

Before start_here is approved (gate off): qualify_budget template first; band tapped -> W03 finishLeadAd -> the LEADAD-DISCLOSE-v1 session text names the adviser -> W01 routes -> W06 broker intro card.

After the call, W12 asks the lead (reach_check) and thanks her (attended_thanks) only inside the CPA s12 / Reg 4 contact hours (automation/lib/contact-hours.mjs: Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00, Sat 09:00-13:00, never Sunday or a public holiday), like the W01 / W05 / W08 marketing sends.

w02_contract.reader: automation/lib/w01.mjs normaliseLeadAd (a Graph lead, or the W02 ingest item) via leadAdAnswers / leadAdConsent; W02.json passes lead.answers and consent.responses through (automation/patch-w02-instant-form-v2.mjs). Since v3 (automation/patch-w02-instant-form-v3.mjs) the ingest item also carries consent.text (lib/w01.mjs LEAD_AD_CONSENT_TEXT).
w02_contract.matching: An answer is accepted as its option key or its exact label (case, spaces and hyphens ignored). A field whose name is not one of the keys is matched on its value against the label sets. Unknown answers are dropped, never guessed.

checkbox_keys.other_keys: a hand-built form: a ticked box = the consent (Meta refuses a submission without the required box); the ad-measurement choice is then NOT assumed

stored.leads.conv_state.state: start_page (start_here path, via start_page) | q_budget (gate off)
stored.leads.conv_state.age_accepted: true for lt35 / 51plus (and a missing age)
stored.leads.consent_text: the CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form text, word for word (no practice to fill in)
stored.lead_activities: lead_ad_age_out_of_band (lt35 / 51plus), consent_audit, start_page_pending (start_here path) | budget_question_pending (gate off)
stored.leads.work_cover: not set by the form (asked later)

tolerated_missing: smc_age_band (treated like an out-of-band age: books, never qualified)

disclosure_check.generic_consent: The form names no adviser. W01 records consent_mode generic, and routeExisting never hands a generic-consent lead to a broker until adviser_disclosed is on the timeline for THAT broker: /start/ START-DISCLOSE-v1 (start_here path) or the LEADAD-DISCLOSE-v1 session text (gate-off path).
disclosure_check.start_page: The /start/ adviser card (sites/sortmycover/src/lib/start.ts, START-DISCLOSE-v1) shows the adviser, the firm, "an authorised financial services provider (FSP n)", what is shared, and INTRO_DISCLOSURE: "Introduced by SortMyCover. SortMyCover gives no financial advice, product comparisons or premium quotes. Advisers pay SortMyCover a fee that does not depend on whether you buy anything."

sources.used_for: custom_disclaimer_responses is a separate Lead field (not in field_data), entries { checkbox_key, is_checked "1" | "" }.

question { type, key, label, options [{ key, value }] }, is_optimized_for_quality (Higher intent review step), block_display_for_non_targeted_viewer, thank_you_page fields. No character limits are published.

Insurance ads: 18+ targeting; licence / authorisation where the country requires it; ads must not request personally identifiable or financial information such as bank details. South Africa is not named.

The Financial products and services special ad category is required for ads based in or targeting the United States (credit ads also Canada and parts of Europe). Not South Africa: no special ad category on this campaign.

Secondary (policy tracker): Lead Ads must not request insurance information, incl. policy numbers, without Meta's prior permission. Meta's own lead-ads terms page (facebook.com/legal/leadgen/tos) could not be fetched (redirect loop); the same tracker logs an unverified July 2026 removal of this clause. Treated as still in force.
Secondary: financial information (incl. income, net worth, debt) needs prior permission: why the budget band stays off the form.
